title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Romblon National High School-Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon to Odiongan National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Romblon National High School-Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon to Odiongan National High School

text.en: Renaming of a National High School. – The name of Romblon National High School - Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon is hereby changed to Odiongan National High School.
Location of the Main Campus. - The main campus of the Odiongan National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
